defects_found.description: a certificate name "a.*.test" matched the host verbatim because the exact comparison ran before any wildcard reasoning
defects_found.fix: a name containing an asterisk is treated only as a pattern, never as a literal

defects_found.description: the pattern "*.<base>" accepted an empty first label, so ".wild.test" matched
defects_found.fix: the first label must satisfy the LDH rule and be non-empty

defects_found.description: hosts with NUL, tab, space, slash, backslash or non-ASCII separators reached the comparison unchecked
defects_found.fix: _usable_host rejects control characters, separators and non-ASCII, and caps the length at 253

notable: openssl refused to sign a certificate with a literal "a.*.test" SAN, so that case is covered by the unit matrix rather than a live handshake

covers: IP not matched by a wildcard
